title: corybas fordhamii
intro: Corybas fordhamii, commonly known as the Fordham's sundew or more specifically Fordham's corybas, is a carnivorous plant species belonging to the genus Corybas. This plant is known for its unique ability to capture and digest insects for nutrients. The health benefits associated with Corybas fordhamii include its potential to aid in wound healing and the reduction of inflammation due to the presence of bioactive compounds. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including iridoids, which exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
